name: What is the difference between a single-handle and a double-handle faucet?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a single-handle and a double-handle faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: A single-handle faucet controls both water temperature and flow with one lever, offering convenience and a sleek look. You adjust the temperature by moving the handle left or right and the flow by moving it up or down. A double-handle faucet features separate handles for hot and cold water, allowing for precise temperature control by blending the water from two distinct sources. This style often provides a more traditional or classic aesthetic. The choice depends on personal preference, style, and desired functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Single-handle faucets use one lever for temperature and flow, while double-handle faucets have separate controls for hot and cold water. The choice depends on preference and style.
